subject: SolarWave MAP kickoff & CS handover — post-signature onboarding plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Parker <evelyn.parker@solarwaveenergy.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@solarwaveenergy.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SolarWave MAP kickoff & CS handover — post-signature onboarding plan

Hi team — great to be live with SolarWave. Contract executed yesterday (SOW attached). Quick note to start the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and hand the day‑to‑day to CS.

Why this email: get everyone aligned on roles, evaluation milestones, and a tight 60‑day close-to-production plan.

High level timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): SOW signed, access provisioning, initial tech intro call
- Week 1–2: Evaluation runs with 2 pilot prompts + security checklist (SOC2 scope items)
- Week 3–4: Performance tuning, KV caching and cost baseline
- Week 5–8: Production rollout (canary routes), training for end users, SLA handoff

Roles:
- Jordan Blake (me) — deal owner through Q1 handoff, overall escalation
- Monica Patel — assigned CSM (owner of onboarding + MAP execution)
- Marissa Cole — Sales lead for expansion/contract follow-ups
- SolarWave: Evelyn (procurement/PO), Miguel (technical lead)

Attachments: SolarWave_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), SW_eval_matrix.xlsx (suggested evaluation metrics), signed_SOW_SW-2028-145.pdf

Immediate asks:
1) Monica — can you confirm availability for a 30‑minute kickoff with SolarWave this Thursday (Feb 16) 10–10:30 PT?
2) SolarWave — please confirm the list of test datasets end of day Thu so we can prepare tokens/ingest access
3) Marissa — FYI on billing cadence and committed capacity; I flagged an initial credit for first month if we need to accelerate evaluation.

Thanks — attaching MAP draft for Monica to iterate.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415‑555‑0198

Subject: Re: SolarWave MAP kickoff & CS handover — post-signature onboarding plan

Thanks Jordan — congrats on the close! Monica here (CSM) — I'll take lead on the MAP and run the onboarding schedule. A few clarifying notes and next steps from the CS side: 

1) Kickoff: Thursday Feb 16 at 10:00 PT works for me. I'll send a calendar invite to SolarWave and add a short agenda (access, eval success criteria, integration owners).
2) Evaluation plan: I reviewed SW_eval_matrix.xlsx and proposed the following primary success metrics: latency p95 <= 550ms, top‑1 accuracy on canonical prompts >= 88%, token cost per 1k <= $X (we'll finalize). Please confirm these with Miguel.
3) Security & compliance: I'll request SOC2 in-scope artifacts and a list of required retention controls. Jordan — can you drop the signed SOC2 attestation link if you have it?
4) Access: For the pilot we need API keys scoped to a sandbox environment + sample dataset (CSV or Parquet). SolarWave, can you share an S3 read-only bucket or sample files?

I'll produce an updated MAP (v1.1) during the call and distribute action items with owners and due dates.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
